description: We are CODE GAVA, a team of four passionate first-year B.Tech CSE (AI) students interested in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Web Development. We have skills in Python, HTML, and CSS and love exploring innovative ideas to solve real-world problems. We are looking for creative, dedicated teammates with skills in AI/ML, full-stack development, UI/UX design, Python, and problem-solving. Let's learn, innovate, and build something impactful together!
